g.text: Share of countries by gender of the chief executive
"Chief executive" is defined here as the head of state or the head of government, whoever has more power over
the appointment and dismissal of cabinet ministers.
Note: This is recorded on December 31 of each year. When the head of state and head of government hold equal power, the head of
government is considered the chief executive.
